# _assets.mdx

Source: https://github.com/gotenberg/gotenberg.dev/blob/main/docs/convert-with-chromium/_shared/_assets.mdx

import CodeBlock from "@theme/CodeBlock";

## Assets

Send images, fonts, and stylesheets alongside your HTML.

  curl={`
--request ${props.method} http://localhost:3000${props.path} \\
${props.curlFormData}
--form files=@/path/to/img.png \\
${props.curlOutput}
`}

All uploaded files are stored in a single flat directory. Reference assets by **filename only**: no absolute paths (`/img.png`) or subdirectories (`./assets/img.png`).

**✅ Correct Reference**

Since `index.html` and `logo.png` sit side-by-side in the container:

{props.isMarkdown ? (

<CodeBlock language="html" title="index.html">
  {`<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
  <head>
    <meta charset="utf-8" />
    <title>My PDF</title>
  </head>
  <body>
    {{ toHTML "file.md" }}
    <img src="logo.png" />
  </body>
</html>`}
</CodeBlock>
) : (<CodeBlock language="html" title="index.html">
  {`<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
  <head>
    <meta charset="utf-8" />
    <title>My PDF</title>
  </head>
  <body>
    <h1>Hello world!</h1>
    <img src="logo.png" />
  </body>
</html>`}
</CodeBlock>
)}

**❌ Incorrect Reference**

Gotenberg does not recreate your local folder structure (e.g., images/) inside the container.

{props.isMarkdown ? (

<CodeBlock language="html" title="index.html">
  {`<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
  <head>
    <meta charset="utf-8" />
    <title>My PDF</title>
  </head>
  <body>
    {{ toHTML "file.md" }}
    <img src="/images/logo.png" />
  </body>
</html>`}
</CodeBlock>
) : (<CodeBlock language="html" title="index.html">
  {`<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
  <head>
    <meta charset="utf-8" />
    <title>My PDF</title>
  </head>
  <body>
    <h1>Hello world!</h1>
    <img src="/images/logo.png" />
  </body>
</html>`}
</CodeBlock>
)}

For remote URLs (CDNs, Google Fonts), make sure the container can resolve the domain. You cannot use `localhost` from inside the container. Use `host.docker.internal` or your host's network IP instead.

For small assets, Base64 data URIs eliminate network dependencies entirely. Avoid the HTML `<base>` element: it breaks the link between your HTML and uploaded assets.

# _console.mdx

## Console

  formFields={[
      name: "failOnConsoleExceptions",
      type: "boolean",
      defaultValue: "false",
        "Returns a 409 Conflict response if there are exceptions in the Chromium console.",
  curl={`
--request ${props.method} http://localhost:3000${props.path} \\
${props.curlFormData}
--form failOnConsoleExceptions=true \\
${props.curlOutput}
`}
  responses={[
    status: 409,
    message: "Conflict",

Body:

at file:///tmp/db09d2c8-31e3-4058-9923-c2705350f2b3/index.html:18:11;
exception "Uncaught" (20:10): Error: Exception 2
at file:///tmp/db09d2c8-31e3-4058-9923-c2705350f2b3/index.html:21:11:
`,

# _header_footer.mdx

Source: https://github.com/gotenberg/gotenberg.dev/blob/main/docs/convert-with-chromium/_shared/_header_footer.mdx

## Header & Footer

Inject a custom header and footer into every page by uploading `header.html` and `footer.html` files.

Headers and footers render in a separate Chromium context: your main page's CSS does not apply, JavaScript won't execute, and external resources (images, fonts, stylesheets) won't load.

  formFiles={[
      name: "header.html",
      type: "file",
      defaultValue: "None",
      description: "Complete HTML document for the header.",
      name: "footer.html",
      type: "file",
      defaultValue: "None",
      description: "Complete HTML document for the footer.",
  curl={`
--request ${props.method} http://localhost:3000${props.path} \\
${props.curlFormData}
--form files=@/path/to/header.html \\
--form files=@/path/to/footer.html \\
${props.curlOutput}
`}

### HTML Structure

Each file must be a full HTML document with its own `<html>`, `<head>`, and `<body>` tags.

```html
<html>
  <head>
    <style>
      html {
        /* Recommended: Use a larger font-size than normal */
        font-size: 16px;
        /* Recommended: Use margins to align with the page edge */
        margin: 0 20px;
        /* Required for background colors to show */
        -webkit-print-color-adjust: exact;
      }
    </style>
  </head>
  <body>
    <p>
      Page <span class="pageNumber"></span> of <span class="totalPages"></span>
    </p>
  </body>
</html>
```

### Dynamic Content Injection

Chromium automatically injects values into elements with specific class names:

| Class Name       | Injected Value             |
| :--------------- | :------------------------- |
| **`date`**       | The formatted print date   |
| **`title`**      | The document title.        |
| **`url`**        | The document location.     |
| **`pageNumber`** | The current page number.   |
| **`totalPages`** | The total number of pages. |

:::tip Timezone

The environment variable `TZ` allows you to override the default "UTC" timezone.

:::

### Styling & Asset Limitations

| Component   | Rule                                                                                                          |
| :---------- | :------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| **Images**  | Must be Base64 encoded inline (`<img src="data:image/png;base64,...">`). External URLs won't load.            |
| **Fonts**   | Only fonts installed in the Docker image are available. See [Fonts configuration](/docs/configuration#fonts). |
| **Colors**  | Add `-webkit-print-color-adjust: exact;` to force background/text colors.                                     |
| **Margins** | Content taller than `marginTop` / `marginBottom` will be clipped.                                             |
| **CSS**     | `footer.html` styles may override `header.html` styles. Use unique class names.                               |

Do not load external assets (CSS, images, scripts) in headers or footers. They will time out or cause the request to fail.

---

# _http_networking.mdx

Source: https://github.com/gotenberg/gotenberg.dev/blob/main/docs/convert-with-chromium/_shared/_http_networking.mdx

## HTTP & Networking

### Cookies

A JSON array of cookie objects for authentication or session state.

| Key            | Description                                                              | Default                                                          |
| :------------- | :----------------------------------------------------------------------- | :--------------------------------------------------------------- |
| **`name`**     | The name of the cookie.                                                  | <span style={{color: 'var(--ifm-color-danger)'}}>Required</span> |
| **`value`**    | The value of the cookie.                                                 | <span style={{color: 'var(--ifm-color-danger)'}}>Required</span> |
| **`domain`**   | The domain the cookie applies to (e.g., `example.com`).                  | <span style={{color: 'var(--ifm-color-danger)'}}>Required</span> |
| **`path`**     | The URL path the cookie applies to.                                      | `None`                                                           |
| **`secure`**   | If `true`, the cookie is only sent over HTTPS.                           | `None`                                                           |
| **`httpOnly`** | If `true`, the cookie is inaccessible to JavaScript (`document.cookie`). | `None`                                                           |
| **`sameSite`** | Controls cross-site behavior. Values: `"Strict"`, `"Lax"`, `"None"`.     | `None`                                                           |

Cookies expire when the request reaches its time limit. For strict isolation between conversions, configure the API to clear the cookie jar after every request. See [API module configuration](/docs/configuration#api).

  formFields={[
      name: "cookies",
      type: "json",
      defaultValue: "None",
      description: "Array of cookies to add to the request.",
  curl={`
--request ${props.method} http://localhost:3000${props.path} \\
${props.curlFormData}
--form 'cookies=[{"name":"yummy_cookie","value":"choco","domain":"theyummycookie.com"}]' \\
${props.curlOutput}
`}

### HTTP Headers

A JSON object of headers sent with every browser request (including images, stylesheets, scripts).

To restrict a header to specific URLs, append `;scope=` with a regex. The scope token is stripped before sending.

**Example:** `"X-Internal-Token": "secret-123;scope=.*\\.internal\\.api"`

- `https://data.internal.api/v1` → header sent
- `https://google.com/fonts` → header not sent

  formFields={[
      name: "extraHttpHeaders",
      type: "json",
      defaultValue: "None",
      description: "Custom HTTP headers for the request.",
      name: "userAgent",
      type: "string",
      defaultValue: "None",
      description: "Overrides the default User-Agent header.",
  curl={`
--request ${props.method} http://localhost:3000${props.path} \\
${props.curlFormData}
--form 'userAgent="Mozilla/5.0 (X11; Linux x86_64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko)"' \\
--form-string 'extraHttpHeaders={"X-Header":"value","X-Scoped-Header":"value;scope=https?:\\/\\/([a-zA-Z0-9-]+\\.)*domain\\.com\\/.*"}' \\
${props.curlOutput}
`}

### Invalid HTTP Status Codes

Return a `409 Conflict` if the main page or its resources return specific HTTP status codes (JSON array of integers).

| Field                               | Description                                                          |
| :---------------------------------- | :------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| **`failOnHttpStatusCodes`**         | Fails if the **main page** URL returns a matching code.              |
| **`failOnResourceHttpStatusCodes`** | Fails if **any asset** (image, CSS, script) returns a matching code. |

#### Status Code Ranges

Ranges use the **X99** notation:

- `499` matches every code from **400 to 499**.
- `599` matches every code from **500 to 599**.

#### Domain Exclusions

Exclude third-party assets (analytics, tracking scripts) from status code checks with `ignoreResourceHttpStatusDomains`. Matches if the hostname equals or is a subdomain of the entry. Values are normalized (trimmed, lowercased, port/scheme stripped):

- `example.com`
- `*.example.com` or `.example.com`
- `example.com:443` (port is ignored)
- `https://example.com/path` (scheme/path are ignored)

  formFields={[
      name: "failOnHttpStatusCodes",
      type: "json",
      defaultValue: "[499,599]",
        "Returns a 409 Conflict if Gotenberg receives these codes for the main URL.",
      name: "failOnResourceHttpStatusCodes",
      type: "json",
      defaultValue: "None",
        "Returns a 409 Conflict if Gotenberg receives these codes for at least one resource (images/css/etc.).",
      name: "ignoreResourceHttpStatusDomains",
      type: "json",
      defaultValue: "None",
        "Excludes resources from failOnResourceHttpStatusCodes checks based on their hostname.",
  curl={`
--request ${props.method} http://localhost:3000${props.path} \\
${props.curlFormData}
--form 'failOnHttpStatusCodes=[499,599]' \\
--form 'failOnResourceHttpStatusCodes=[499,599]' \\
--form 'ignoreResourceHttpStatusDomains=["sentry-cdn.com","analytics.example.com"]' \\
${props.curlOutput}
`}
  responses={[
      status: 409,
      message: "Conflict",
        "The main page or one of its resources returned an invalid status code.",
      body: `
Content-Type: text/plain; charset=UTF-8
Gotenberg-Trace: {trace}
Body: Invalid HTTP status code from the main page: 400: Bad Request
`,

### Network Errors

If the browser hits a critical network error on the main page, the API returns `400 Bad Request`:

- `net::ERR_CONNECTION_CLOSED`
- `net::ERR_CONNECTION_RESET`
- `net::ERR_CONNECTION_REFUSED`
- `net::ERR_CONNECTION_ABORTED`
- `net::ERR_CONNECTION_FAILED`
- `net::ERR_NAME_NOT_RESOLVED`
- `net::ERR_INTERNET_DISCONNECTED`
- `net::ERR_ADDRESS_UNREACHABLE`
- `net::ERR_BLOCKED_BY_CLIENT`
- `net::ERR_BLOCKED_BY_RESPONSE`
- `net::ERR_FILE_NOT_FOUND`
- `net::ERR_HTTP2_PROTOCOL_ERROR`

By default, Chromium does not wait for network activity to settle before converting. Two form fields control this behavior:

- `skipNetworkIdleEvent` set to `false`: waits until **zero** open connections persist for 500ms. Strictest option, but pages with long-polling or analytics connections may never reach this state.
- `skipNetworkAlmostIdleEvent` set to `false`: waits until **at most 2** open connections persist for 500ms. A practical middle ground for pages that keep a background connection alive (WebSockets, analytics pings, heartbeat polls).

Both default to `true` (no wait). If both are set to `false`, both events must fire before conversion proceeds.

A broken image or stylesheet won't fail the conversion on its own. The PDF is generated with missing assets. Set `failOnResourceLoadingFailed` to `true` to fail on any resource network error.

  formFields={[
      name: "skipNetworkIdleEvent",
      type: "boolean",
      defaultValue: "true",
        "Does not wait for Chromium network to be idle (0 open connections for 500ms).",
      name: "skipNetworkAlmostIdleEvent",
      type: "boolean",
      defaultValue: "true",
        "Does not wait for Chromium network to be almost idle (at most 2 open connections for 500ms).",
      name: "failOnResourceLoadingFailed",
      type: "boolean",
      defaultValue: "false",
        "Returns a 400 Bad Request if assets (images/css/etc.) fail to load due to network errors.",
  curl={`
--request ${props.method} http://localhost:3000${props.path} \\
${props.curlFormData}
--form skipNetworkIdleEvent=false \\
--form skipNetworkAlmostIdleEvent=false \\
--form failOnResourceLoadingFailed=true \\
${props.curlOutput}
`}

### Outbound URL Filtering

Chromium routes every HTTP/HTTPS request through an in-process pinning proxy. The proxy resolves DNS once and dials the validated IP, closing the rebind window.

`file://` sub-resources are scoped to the request's own working directory. Sibling requests' files are unreachable.

Forbidden URLs return `403`. See [Outbound URL Filtering](/docs/outbound-url-filtering) for posture, recipes, and configuration.

---

# _emulated_media_features.mdx

Source: https://github.com/gotenberg/gotenberg.dev/blob/main/docs/convert-with-chromium/_shared/_rendering_behavior/_emulated_media_features.mdx

### Emulated Media Features

You can simulate specific browser conditions by overriding CSS media features. This is particularly useful for forcing "Dark Mode" or testing layouts with reduced motion.

The `emulatedMediaFeatures` form field expects a JSON array of objects, where each object contains a `name` and a `value`.

**Common Media Features:**

| Feature Name             | Common Values             | Description                                                              |
| :----------------------- | :------------------------ | :----------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `prefers-color-scheme`   | `light`, `dark`           | Emulates the user's OS color theme preference.                           |
| `prefers-reduced-motion` | `no-preference`, `reduce` | Emulates the setting to minimize non-essential motion.                   |
| `color-gamut`            | `srgb`, `p3`, `rec2020`   | Emulates the approximate range of colors supported by the output device. |
| `forced-colors`          | `none`, `active`          | Emulates "High Contrast" modes where the browser restricts colors.       |

  formFields={[
      name: "emulatedMediaFeatures",
      type: "json",
      defaultValue: "None",
        "A JSON array of objects to override CSS media features (e.g., prefers-color-scheme).",
  curl={`
--request ${props.method} http://localhost:3000${props.path} \\
${props.curlFormData}
--form emulatedMediaFeatures='[{"name": "prefers-color-scheme", "value": "dark"}, {"name": "prefers-reduced-motion", "value": "reduce"}]' \\
${props.curlOutput}
`}

---

## Rendering Behavior

### Page Layout

  formFields={[
      name: "paperWidth",
      type: "string",
      defaultValue: "8.5",
        "Paper width (e.g. 8.5in). Standard units supported (in, pt, cm). Default is inches.",
      name: "paperHeight",
      type: "string",
      defaultValue: "11",
        "Paper height (e.g. 11in). Standard units supported (in, pt, cm). Default is inches.",
      name: "marginTop",
      type: "string",

        "Top margin (e.g. 0.39in). Standard units supported (in, pt, cm). Default is inches.",
      name: "marginBottom",
      type: "string",
      defaultValue: "0.39",
        "Bottom margin (e.g. 0.39in). Standard units supported (in, pt, cm). Default is inches.",
      name: "marginLeft",
      type: "string",
      defaultValue: "0.39",
        "Left margin (e.g. 0.39in). Standard units supported (in, pt, cm). Default is inches.",
      name: "marginRight",
      type: "string",
      defaultValue: "0.39",
        "Right margin (e.g. 0.39in). Standard units supported (in, pt, cm). Default is inches.",
      name: "landscape",
      type: "boolean",
      defaultValue: "false",
      description: "Sets the paper orientation to landscape.",
      name: "scale",
      type: "number",
      defaultValue: "1.0",
      description: "The scale of the page rendering (zoom factor).",
      name: "singlePage",

      defaultValue: "false",
      description: "Forces the entire content to fit on one very long page.",

  curl={`

--form marginTop=1 \\
--form marginBottom=1 \\
--form marginLeft=1 \\
--form marginRight=1 \\

--form scale=2.0 \\
${props.curlOutput}
`}

### Background Logic

  formFields={[
      name: "printBackground",
      type: "boolean",
      defaultValue: "false",
      description: "Includes background graphics/colors from the HTML.",
      name: "omitBackground",
      type: "boolean",
      defaultValue: "false",
      description: "Hides the default white background (allows transparency).",
  curl={`
--request ${props.method} http://localhost:3000${props.path} \\
${props.curlFormData}
--form printBackground=true \\
${props.curlOutput}
`}

The final background depends on `printBackground`, `omitBackground`, and your document's CSS:

| Print Background? | Omit Background? | HTML CSS has BG? | **Resulting Output**         |
| :---------------- | :--------------- | :--------------- | :--------------------------- |
| `false`           | _(Any)_          | _(Any)_          | **No Background**            |
| `true`            | _(Any)_          | **Yes**          | **Uses HTML CSS Background** |
| `true`            | `true`           | **No**           | **Transparent**              |
| `true`            | `false`          | **No**           | **White (Default)**          |

When `singlePage` is `true`, it overrides `paperHeight` and `nativePageRanges`.

### Standard Paper Sizes

Dimensions in inches (width × height):

| Format | Dimensions   | Format (US) | Dimensions         |
| :----- | :----------- | :---------- | :----------------- |
| **A6** | 4.13 x 5.83  | **Letter**  | 8.5 x 11 (Default) |
| **A5** | 5.83 x 8.27  | **Legal**   | 8.5 x 14           |
| **A4** | 8.27 x 11.7  | **Tabloid** | 11 x 17            |
| **A3** | 11.7 x 16.54 | **Ledger**  | 17 x 11            |
| **A2** | 16.54 x 23.4 |             |                    |
| **A1** | 23.4 x 33.1  |             |                    |
| **A0** | 33.1 x 46.8  |             |                    |

### Print Media

Chromium defaults to `print` media: backgrounds are removed and layout is optimized for ink. If your PDF looks different from the browser, this is probably why.

- `@media print` in CSS lets you hide elements (nav bars, buttons) from the PDF.
- Set `emulatedMediaType` to `screen` to match the browser viewport.
- Enable `printBackground` to include background colors and images.
- Control paper size and margins via the CSS `@page` rule (requires `preferCssPageSize`).

  formFields={[
      name: "emulatedMediaType",
      type: "enum",
      defaultValue: "print",
      description: "Media type to emulate (`screen` or `print`).",
  curl={`
--request ${props.method} http://localhost:3000${props.path} \\
${props.curlFormData}
--form emulatedMediaType=screen \\
${props.curlOutput}
`}

<EmulatedMediaFeatures
  method={props.method}
  path={props.path}
  curlFormData={props.curlFormData}
  curlOutput={props.curlOutput}

<WaitFor
  method={props.method}
  path={props.path}
  curlFormData={props.curlFormData}
  curlOutput={props.curlOutput}
  isPDF={true}

import EmulatedMediaFeatures from "./_emulated_media_features.mdx";
import WaitFor from "./_wait_for.mdx";

## Rendering Behavior

  formFields={[
      name: "width",
      type: "integer",
      defaultValue: "800",
      description: "The device screen width in pixels.",
      name: "height",
      type: "integer",
      defaultValue: "600",
      description: "The device screen height in pixels.",
      name: "clip",
      type: "boolean",
      defaultValue: "false",
        "Define whether to clip the screenshot according to the device dimensions.",
      name: "deviceScaleFactor",
      type: "number",
      defaultValue: "1",
        "The device scale ratio, controlling the screenshot pixel density. Set to `2` for retina-quality output.",
      name: "format",
      type: "enum",
      defaultValue: "png",
        "The image compression format. Options: `png`, `jpeg`, `webp`.",
      name: "quality",
      type: "integer",
      defaultValue: "100",
        "The compression quality (0-100). Only used if format is `jpeg`.",
      name: "omitBackground",
      type: "boolean",
      defaultValue: "false",
      description: "Hides the default white background to allow transparency.",
      name: "optimizeForSpeed",
      type: "boolean",
      defaultValue: "false",
        "Optimizes image encoding for speed rather than resulting file size.",
  curl={`
--request ${props.method} http://localhost:3000${props.path} \\
${props.curlFormData}
--form width=1280 \\
--form height=720 \\
--form format=jpeg \\
--form quality=85 \\
--form optimizeForSpeed=true \\
${props.curlOutput}
`}

### Viewport & Layout

**The viewport defines the image.** Unlike PDFs which paginate content, screenshots capture the browser's viewport exactly as rendered.

- **Resolution:** Ensure you set the `width` and `height` form fields to match your desired target device (e.g., `1920`x`1080` for desktop, `375`x`812` for mobile).
- **Pixel density:** Raise `deviceScaleFactor` for high-DPI output. A value of `2` doubles the captured pixels, matching a retina display.
- If your screenshot's content is repeated and clipped, consider setting the `skipNetworkIdleEvent` form field to false (see issue [#1065](https://github.com/gotenberg/gotenberg/issues/1065#issuecomment-2670882337)).

:::tip

If you are simulating a mobile device, remember to also set the `userAgent` to match a mobile browser, or the site might serve the desktop version.

:::

<EmulatedMediaFeatures
  method={props.method}
  path={props.path}
  curlFormData={props.curlFormData}
  curlOutput={props.curlOutput}

### Image Format

Choosing the right output format impacts quality and file size:

- **PNG:** Best for screenshots containing text, UI elements, or flat colors. It is lossless, ensuring text remains sharp.
- **JPEG:** Best for screenshots containing photographs or complex gradients. `quality` balances file size against visual fidelity (default is `100`).
- **WebP:** Offers a modern balance of compression and quality, usually superior to JPEG.

<WaitFor
  method={props.method}
  path={props.path}
  curlFormData={props.curlFormData}
  curlOutput={props.curlOutput}
  isPDF={false}

# _wait_for.mdx

Source: https://github.com/gotenberg/gotenberg.dev/blob/main/docs/convert-with-chromium/_shared/_rendering_behavior/_wait_for.mdx

### JavaScript & Dynamic Content

**Chromium captures what is currently visible.** If the page relies on JavaScript to render data, charts, or external content, the conversion might trigger _before_ the rendering is complete, resulting in blank or incomplete sections.

:::info Cheatsheets

If the content is generated dynamically:

1.  `waitDelay` adds a fixed pause before conversion.
2.  For more precision, `waitForExpression` triggers the conversion only when a specific JavaScript condition (e.g., `window.status === 'ready'`) is met.

:::

### Wait Delay

Use this as a fallback when you cannot modify the target page's code. It forces Gotenberg to wait for a fixed duration before rendering, giving JavaScript time to finish execution.

:::warning Reliability Note

This method is "brute force". If the page loads faster, time is wasted. If it loads slower, the {props.isPDF ? "PDF" : "image" } will be incomplete. Use explicit waits (Expression or Selector) whenever possible.

:::

  formFields={[
      name: "waitDelay",
      type: "duration",
      defaultValue: "None",
      description: "Duration to wait before rendering, e.g. `5s` or `500ms`.",
  curl={`
--request ${props.method} http://localhost:3000${props.path} \\
${props.curlFormData}
--form waitDelay=5s \\
${props.curlOutput}
`}

### Wait For Expression

This is the most robust method for synchronization. It pauses the conversion process until a specific JavaScript expression evaluates to `true` within the page context. This ensures the { props.isPDF ? "PDF" : "image" } is generated exactly when your data is ready.

**Example: Client-side logic**

```js
// Inside your HTML page.
window.status = "loading";

fetchData().then(() => {
  renderCharts();
  // Signal to Gotenberg that the page is ready.
  window.status = "ready";
});
```

  formFields={[
      name: "waitForExpression",
      type: "string",
      defaultValue: "None",
        "JavaScript expression evaluated in the page; rendering starts when it returns true.",
  curl={`
--request ${props.method} http://localhost:3000${props.path} \\
${props.curlFormData}
--form 'waitForExpression=window.status === '\\''ready'\\''' \\
${props.curlOutput}
`}

### Wait For Selector

Ideally suited for Single Page Applications (SPAs) or frameworks like React/Vue. This method delays the conversion until a specific HTML element - identified by a CSS selector - appears in the DOM.

**Example: Dynamic Element Injection**

```js
// Inside your HTML page.
await heavyCalculation();

const completionMarker = document.createElement("div");
completionMarker.id = "app-ready"; // The selector we wait for.
document.body.appendChild(completionMarker);
```

  formFields={[
      name: "waitForSelector",
      type: "string",
      defaultValue: "None",
        "CSS selector; rendering starts when a matching element appears in the DOM.",
  curl={`
--request ${props.method} http://localhost:3000${props.path} \\
${props.curlFormData}
--form 'waitForSelector=#app-ready' \\
${props.curlOutput}
`}

---

# _split_page_ranges.mdx

Source: https://github.com/gotenberg/gotenberg.dev/blob/main/docs/convert-with-chromium/_shared/_split_page_ranges.mdx

import SyntaxValidationSplitPDFEngines from "../../_shared/_syntax_validation_split_pdfengines.mdx";

## Split & Page Ranges

### Native Printing (Chromium)

Happens _during_ conversion. Faster, as unused pages are never rendered. Control page breaks with CSS: `break-inside: avoid`, `break-before: always`, `break-after: always`.

  formFields={[
      name: "nativePageRanges",
      type: "string",
      defaultValue: "None",
      description: "Define ranges to print (e.g., `1-5, 8, 11-13`).",
  curl={`
--request ${props.method} http://localhost:3000${props.path} \\
${props.curlFormData}
--form nativePageRanges=1-5 \\
-o my.pdf
`}

### Post-Processing (PDF Engines) {#post-processing-pdf-engines-split-page-ranges}

Splits pages _after_ the PDF has been generated using a PDF engine (like pdfcpu). Returns a ZIP archive, or a single PDF in 'pages' mode with `splitUnify=true`.

<SyntaxValidationSplitPDFEngines />

  formFields={[
      name: "splitMode",
      type: "enum",
      defaultValue: "None",
        "Activates the splitting engine. Options: `intervals` or `pages`.",
      name: "splitSpan",
      type: "string",
      defaultValue: "None",
        "The rule for splitting. If mode is `intervals`, defines the chunk size (e.g. `2`). If mode is `pages`, defines the page ranges.",
      name: "splitUnify",
      type: "boolean",
      defaultValue: "false",
        "Only for `pages` mode. If true, puts all extracted pages into a single PDF file. If false, creates a separate file for each range.",
  curl={`
--request ${props.method} http://localhost:3000${props.path} \\
${props.curlFormData}
--form splitMode=intervals \\
--form splitSpan=1 \\
-o my.zip
`}

### Document Outline (Chromium)

# _watermark_stamp.mdx

Source: https://github.com/gotenberg/gotenberg.dev/blob/main/docs/convert-with-chromium/_shared/_watermark_stamp.mdx

import WatermarkPDFEngines from "../../_shared/_watermark_pdfengines.mdx";
import StampPDFEngines from "../../_shared/_stamp_pdfengines.mdx";

## Watermark & Stamp

### Native Watermark (HTML/CSS)

Add a watermark directly in your HTML with CSS pseudo-elements. Rendered _behind_ the page content during conversion, no post-processing needed.

```css
body {
  position: relative;
}

body::before {
  content: "CONFIDENTIAL";
  position: fixed;
  inset: 0;
  z-index: -1;
  display: grid;
  justify-content: center;
  align-content: center;
  font-size: 160px;
  font-weight: bold;
  opacity: 0.08;
  transform: rotate(-45deg);
  pointer-events: none;
}
```

### Native Stamp (HTML/CSS)

A stamp works the same way but is rendered _on top of_ the page content using `::after` and a positive `z-index`.

```css
body::after {
  content: "APPROVED";
  position: fixed;
  top: 40px;
  right: 40px;
  z-index: 9999;
  padding: 10px 28px;
  border: 4px solid rgba(0, 128, 0, 0.6);
  border-radius: 8px;
  font-size: 36px;
  font-weight: bold;
  color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 0.6);
  transform: rotate(-12deg);
  pointer-events: none;
}
```

### Watermark (PDF Engines)

<WatermarkPDFEngines
  showCurlExample={true}
  method={props.method}
  path={props.path}
  curlFormData={props.curlFormData}
  curlOutput={props.curlOutput}

### Stamp (PDF Engines)

<StampPDFEngines
  showCurlExample={true}
  method={props.method}
  path={props.path}
  curlFormData={props.curlFormData}
  curlOutput={props.curlOutput}

# convert-html-to-pdf.mdx

id: convert-html-to-pdf
title: Convert HTML to PDF

import ConfigurationInfo from "./_shared/_configuration_info.mdx";
import Assets from "./_shared/_assets.mdx";
import RenderingBehaviorPDF from "./_shared/_rendering_behavior/_rendering_behavior_pdf.mdx";
import HttpNetworking from "./_shared/_http_networking.mdx";

Converts an `index.html` file (and optional assets) to PDF using Headless Chromium. Reference additional CSS, images, and fonts in your HTML using relative paths.

<ConfigurationInfo />

## Basics

  method="POST"
  path="/forms/chromium/convert/html"
  headers={[
      name: "Gotenberg-Output-Filename",
      type: "string",
      required: false,
        "The filename of the resulting file - Gotenberg automatically appends the file extension. Defaults to a random UUID filename.",
      name: "Gotenberg-Trace",
      type: "string",
      required: false,
        "A custom request ID to identify the request in the logs; overrides the default UUID.",
  formFiles={[
      name: "index.html",
      type: "file",
      required: true,
      description: "An HTML file named `index.html` to convert into PDF.",
  curl={`
--request POST http://localhost:3000/forms/chromium/convert/html \\
--form files=@/path/to/index.html \\
-o my.pdf`}
  responses={[
      status: 200,
      message: "OK",
      description: "The PDF file has been successfully created.",
      body: `
Content-Disposition: attachment; filename={output-filename.pdf}
Content-Type: {content-type}
Content-Length: {content-length}
Gotenberg-Trace: {trace}
Body: {output-file}
      `,
      status: 400,
      message: "Bad Request",
      description: "The request had one or more invalid form fields.",
      body: `
Content-Type: text/plain; charset=UTF-8
Gotenberg-Trace: {trace}
Body: {error}
      `,
      status: 503,
      message: "Service Unavailable",
        "The request did not complete within the configured maximum duration.",
      body: `
Content-Type: text/plain; charset=UTF-8
Gotenberg-Trace: {trace}
Body: {error}
      `,

<RenderingBehaviorPDF

# convert-markdown-to-pdf.mdx

Source: https://github.com/gotenberg/gotenberg.dev/blob/main/docs/convert-with-chromium/convert-markdown-to-pdf.mdx

---
id: convert-markdown-to-pdf
title: Convert Markdown to PDF
---

import ConfigurationInfo from "./_shared/_configuration_info.mdx";
import Assets from "./_shared/_assets.mdx";
import RenderingBehaviorPDF from "./_shared/_rendering_behavior/_rendering_behavior_pdf.mdx";
import HttpNetworking from "./_shared/_http_networking.mdx";
import Console from "./_shared/_console.mdx";
import HeaderFooter from "./_shared/_header_footer.mdx";
import StructureMetadata from "./_shared/_structure_metadata.mdx";
import SplitPageRanges from "./_shared/_split_page_ranges.mdx";
import WatermarkStamp from "./_shared/_watermark_stamp.mdx";
import Rotate from "./_shared/_rotate.mdx";
import PdfaPdfua from "./_shared/_pdfa_pdfua.mdx";
import Encryption from "./_shared/_encryption.mdx";

Converts Markdown content (with [MathJaX](https://www.mathjax.org/) support) to PDF using Headless Chromium. You provide an `index.html` template and one or more `.md` files. Gotenberg converts the Markdown to HTML and injects it into your template.

:::info Template Configuration

The `index.html` file **must** include the following Go template action where the content should appear:

```html {8}
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
  <head>
    <meta charset="utf-8" />
    <title>My PDF</title>
  </head>
  <body>
    {{ toHTML "file.md" }}
  </body>
</html>
```

:::

<ConfigurationInfo />

## Basics

  method="POST"
  path="/forms/chromium/convert/markdown"
  headers={[
      name: "Gotenberg-Output-Filename",
      type: "string",
      required: false,
        "The filename of the resulting file - Gotenberg automatically appends the file extension. Defaults to a random UUID filename.",
      name: "Gotenberg-Trace",
      type: "string",
      required: false,
        "A custom request ID to identify the request in the logs; overrides the default UUID.",
  formFiles={[
      name: "index.html",
      type: "file",
      required: true,
        "An HTML file named `index.html` to wrap the markdown content.",
      name: "*.md",
      type: "file[]",
      required: true,
      description: "At least one markdown file.",
  curl={`
--request POST http://localhost:3000/forms/chromium/convert/markdown \\
--form files=@/path/to/index.html \\
--form files=@/path/to/file.md \\
-o my.pdf`}
  responses={[
      status: 200,
      message: "OK",
      description: "The PDF file has been successfully created.",

Content-Disposition: attachment; filename={output-filename.pdf}
Content-Type: {content-type}
Content-Length: {content-length}
Gotenberg-Trace: {trace}
Body: {output-file}
      `,
      status: 400,
      message: "Bad Request",
      description: "The request had one or more invalid form fields.",
      body: `
Content-Type: text/plain; charset=UTF-8
Gotenberg-Trace: {trace}
Body: {error}
      `,
      status: 503,
      message: "Service Unavailable",
        "The request did not complete within the configured maximum duration.",

Gotenberg-Trace: {trace}
Body: {error}
      `,

# convert-to-pdf.mdx

Source: https://github.com/gotenberg/gotenberg.dev/blob/main/docs/convert-with-libreoffice/convert-to-pdf.mdx

---
id: convert-to-pdf
title: Convert to PDF
---

import MetadataPDFEngines from "../_shared/_metadata_pdfengines.mdx";
import AttachmentsPDFEngines from "../_shared/_attachments_pdfengines.mdx";
import FacturXPDFEngines from "../_shared/_facturx_pdfengines.mdx";
import SyntaxValidationSplitPDFEngines from "../_shared/_syntax_validation_split_pdfengines.mdx";
import WatermarkPDFEngines from "../_shared/_watermark_pdfengines.mdx";
import StampPDFEngines from "../_shared/_stamp_pdfengines.mdx";
import RotatePDFEngines from "../_shared/_rotate_pdfengines.mdx";
import FlattenPDFEngines from "../_shared/_flatten_pdfengines.mdx";
import EncryptionPDFEngines from "../_shared/_encryption_pdfengines.mdx";

Converts documents to PDF using LibreOffice. Accepts Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint), OpenDocument, plain text, and many other formats. You can upload one or more files per request.

Sections marked **(LibreOffice)** apply during conversion. Sections marked **(PDF Engines)** post-process the resulting PDF with external tools such as QPDF, pdfcpu, and PDFtk; see [PDF Engines](/docs/configuration#pdf-engines).

See the [LibreOffice module configuration](/docs/configuration#libreoffice) for startup and behavior flags.

## Basics

  method="POST"
  path="/forms/libreoffice/convert"
  headers={[
      name: "Gotenberg-Output-Filename",
      type: "string",
      required: false,
        "The filename of the resulting file - Gotenberg automatically appends the file extension. Defaults to a random UUID filename.",
      name: "Gotenberg-Trace",
      type: "string",
      required: false,
        "A custom request ID to identify the request in the logs; overrides the default UUID.",
  formFiles={[
      name: "files",
      type: "file[]",
      required: true,
      description: "At least one file to convert to PDF.",
  curl={`
--request POST http://localhost:3000/forms/libreoffice/convert \\
--form files=@/path/to/docx \\
-o my.pdf`}
  responses={[
      status: 200,
      message: "OK",
      description: "The PDF file. Multiple input files produce a ZIP archive.",
      body: `
Content-Disposition: attachment; filename={output-filename.ext}
Content-Type: {content-type}
Content-Length: {content-length}
Gotenberg-Trace: {trace}
Body: {output-file}
      `,
      status: 400,
      message: "Bad Request",
      description: "The request had one or more invalid form fields.",
      body: `
Content-Type: text/plain; charset=UTF-8
Gotenberg-Trace: {trace}
Body: {error}
      `,
      status: 503,
      message: "Service Unavailable",
        "The request did not complete within the configured maximum duration.",
      body: `
Content-Type: text/plain; charset=UTF-8
Gotenberg-Trace: {trace}
Body: {error}
      `,

## Rendering Behavior

### Layout & Pages

  formFields={[

      description: "Sets the paper orientation to landscape.",

      defaultValue: "false",
        "Ignores each sheet’s paper size, print ranges and shown/hidden status and puts every sheet (even hidden sheets) on exactly one page.",

-o my.pdf`}

### Supported Extensions

| **Spreadsheets**       | `.xls`, `.xlsx`, `.xlsm`, `.xlsb`, `.xlt`, `.xltm`, `.xltx`, `.xlw`, `.ods`, `.fods`, `.ots`, `.csv`, `.numbers`, `.123`, `.wk1`, `.wks`, `.wb2`, `.dbf`, `.dif`, `.slk`, `.sxc`, `.stc`, `.uos`, `.pxl`, `.sdc`                                      |
| **Presentations**      | `.ppt`, `.pptx`, `.pptm`, `.pot`, `.potm`, `.potx`, `.pps`, `.odp`, `.fodp`, `.otp`, `.key`, `.sxi`, `.sti`, `.uop`, `.sdd`, `.sdp`, `.fopd`                                                                                                          |
| **Graphics & Drawing** | `.odg`, `.fodg`, `.otg`, `.vsd`, `.vsdx`, `.vsdm`, `.vdx`, `.cdr`, `.svg`, `.svm`, `.wmf`, `.emf`, `.cgm`, `.dxf`, `.std`, `.sxd`, `.pub`, `.wpg`, `.sda`, `.odd`, `.met`, `.cmx`, `.eps`                                                             |
| **Images**             | `.jpg`, `.jpeg`, `.png`, `.bmp`, `.gif`, `.tif`, `.tiff`, `.pbm`, `.pgm`, `.ppm`, `.xbm`, `.xpm`, `.pcx`, `.pcd`, `.pct`, `.psd`, `.tga`, `.ras`, `.pwp`                                                                                              |
| **Web & Other**        | `.html`, `.htm`, `.xhtml`, `.epub`, `.pdf`, `.pdb`, `.ltx`, `.mml`, `.smf`, `.sxm`, `.sxg`, `.oth`, `.odm`, `.swf`                                                                                                                                    |

LibreOffice is not a 1:1 clone of Microsoft Office. Documents with complex styling, Smart Art, or highly specific formatting may render slightly differently.

### Fonts & Layout Fidelity

LibreOffice relies on installed fonts to calculate page breaks and layout. Missing fonts are the most common cause of layout issues and shifted pagination.

Install all required fonts in your Docker image (via a custom `Dockerfile`). See [Fonts configuration](/docs/configuration#fonts).

### Image Compression

- **Lossless (PNG):** Best for line art, diagrams, or images with flat colors. Enable with `losslessImageCompression`.
- **Lossy (JPEG):** The default. Best for photographs or complex gradients. Significantly smaller file size.

  formFields={[
      name: "losslessImageCompression",
      type: "boolean",
      defaultValue: "false",
        "Uses lossless (PNG) compression instead of lossy (JPEG) for images.",
      name: "quality",
      type: "integer",
      defaultValue: "90",
        "JPEG export quality. Higher values produce better quality but larger files. Between 1 and 100.",
      name: "reduceImageResolution",
      type: "boolean",
      defaultValue: "false",
      description: (
        <span>
          Reduces each image to the resolution specified by{" "}
          <code>maxImageResolution</code>.
        </span>
      ),
      name: "maxImageResolution",
      type: "integer",
      defaultValue: "300",
        "Target resolution in DPI when reduceImageResolution is true. Possible values: 75, 150, 300, 600, 1200.",
  curl={`
--request POST http://localhost:3000/forms/libreoffice/convert \\
--form files=@/path/to/document.docx \\
--form losslessImageCompression=false \\
--form quality=50 \\
--form reduceImageResolution=true \\
--form maxImageResolution=75 \\
-o my.pdf`}

### Links

  formFields={[
      name: "convertOooTargetToPdfTarget",
      type: "boolean",
      defaultValue: "false",
        "Changes .od[tpgs] extensions to .pdf in exported links. The source document remains untouched.",
      name: "exportLinksRelativeFsys",
      type: "boolean",
      defaultValue: "false",
        "Exports file:// hyperlinks as relative to the source document location.",

### Macros

Macros in documents (e.g., `.docm`, `.xlsm`, `.pptm`) are **disabled** by default during conversion. Files are still converted, but macro-generated content will not execute.

### Linked Content

Documents can reference content by link instead of storing it: OOXML images marked `TargetMode="External"`, RTF `INCLUDEPICTURE`, ODT linked images.

Since _8.34.0_, LibreOffice drops linked content: an uploaded document always loads from an untrusted location, so linked `file://` paths and external URLs are not resolved. The conversion still returns `200 OK` with the linked content absent. There is no opt-out; embedded content is unaffected, so embed images instead of linking them.

Since _8.32.0_, any outbound fetch LibreOffice still performs routes through the same pinning proxy used by Chromium. Allow/deny lists and IP-class checks apply. The proxy rejects forbidden destinations inside the conversion, which succeeds without the resource.

See [Outbound URL Filtering](/docs/outbound-url-filtering).

## Structure & Metadata

### Document Outline (LibreOffice)

Configure how LibreOffice generates PDF bookmarks (the sidebar) and internal indexes like the Table of Contents. Your source document must use proper heading styles (e.g., Heading 1, Heading 2) or explicit bookmarks to generate the hierarchy.

  formFields={[
      name: "updateIndexes",
      type: "boolean",
      defaultValue: "true",
        "Updates indexes (e.g., Table of Contents) before conversion. May cause missing links.",
      name: "exportBookmarks",
      type: "boolean",
      defaultValue: "true",
      description: "Exports bookmarks to the PDF.",
      name: "exportBookmarksToPdfDestination",
      type: "boolean",
      defaultValue: "false",
      description: "Exports bookmarks as Named Destinations.",
      name: "addOriginalDocumentAsStream",
      type: "boolean",
      defaultValue: "false",
        "Embeds the original document as a stream in the PDF for archiving.",
  curl={`
--request POST http://localhost:3000/forms/libreoffice/convert \\
--form files=@/path/to/document.docx \\
--form exportBookmarks=false \\
--form exportBookmarksToPdfDestination=true \\
--form updateIndexes=false \\
-o my.pdf`}

### Native Flattening (LibreOffice)

Set `exportFormFields` to `false` to prevent LibreOffice from creating interactive PDF widgets, effectively flattening them during conversion. Faster than post-processing.

This also fixes clipping when form fields reference fonts that aren't embedded: LibreOffice sizes the widget boxes with a fallback font, so they come out too small. Flattening removes the widgets and the mismatch.

  formFields={[
      name: "exportFormFields",
      type: "boolean",
      defaultValue: "true",
        "Exports form fields as interactive widgets. Set to false to flatten them during conversion.",
      name: "allowDuplicateFieldNames",
      type: "boolean",
      defaultValue: "false",
        "Allows multiple exported form fields to share the same field name.",
  curl={`
--request POST http://localhost:3000/forms/libreoffice/convert \\
--form files=@/path/to/document.docx \\
--form exportFormFields=false \\
-o my.pdf`}

## Merge (PDF Engines)

Converts each file to PDF individually, then merges them in **alphanumeric order** (numbers first, then alphabetical).

  formFields={[
      name: "merge",
      type: "boolean",
      required: false,
      description: "Merge the resulting PDFs.",
  curl={`
--request POST http://localhost:3000/forms/libreoffice/convert \\
--form files=@/path/to/1_document.docx \\
--form files=@/path/to/2_document.docx \\
--form merge=true \\
-o my.pdf`}

## Split & Page Ranges

### Native Printing (LibreOffice)

Happens _during_ the conversion. Applied independently to each uploaded file.

  formFields={[
      name: "nativePageRanges",
      type: "string",
      defaultValue: "All pages",
        "Page ranges to print, e.g., `1-4`. Empty means all pages. Applied independently to each file.",
  curl={`
--request POST http://localhost:3000/forms/libreoffice/convert \\
--form files=@/path/to/document.docx \\
--form nativePageRanges=1-5 \\
-o my.pdf`}

### Post-Processing (PDF Engines) {#post-processing-pdf-engines-split-page-ranges}

Splits pages _after_ the PDF has been generated using a PDF engine (pdfcpu, QPDF, or PDFtk). Applied to each file individually, or to the combined output _after_ the merge operation.

<SyntaxValidationSplitPDFEngines />

  formFields={[
      name: "splitMode",
      type: "enum",
      defaultValue: "None",
        "Either `intervals` or `pages`. Configures how the PDF should be split.",
      name: "splitSpan",
      type: "string",
      defaultValue: "None",
        "The intervals or page ranges to extract, based on the splitMode.",
      name: "splitUnify",
      type: "boolean",
      defaultValue: "false",
        "If true, puts extracted pages into a single file. Only works with `pages` mode.",
  curl={`
--request POST http://localhost:3000/forms/libreoffice/convert \\
--form files=@/path/to/document.docx \\
--form splitMode=intervals \\
--form splitSpan=1 \\
-o my.zip`}

## PDF/A & PDF/UA

Use the `pdfa` and `pdfua` form fields to convert the PDF into a standardized format.

- **PDF/A:** Specialized for the digital preservation of electronic documents (Archival).
- **PDF/UA:** Specialized for Universal Accessibility, ensuring documents are accessible to assistive technologies.

  formFields={[
      name: "pdfa",
      type: "enum",
      defaultValue: "None",
        "Converts to a specific PDF/A archival standard. Options: `PDF/A-1b`, `PDF/A-2b`, `PDF/A-3b`.",
      name: "pdfua",
      type: "boolean",
      defaultValue: "false",
      description: "Enables PDF/UA (Universal Accessibility) compliance.",
  curl={`
--request POST http://localhost:3000/forms/libreoffice/convert \\
--form files=@/path/to/document.docx \\
--form pdfa=PDF/A-1b \\
--form pdfua=true \\
-o my.pdf`}

## What's Next?

Combine or transform the result in [Manipulate PDFs](/docs/manipulate-pdfs/merge-pdfs), or deliver it asynchronously with [webhooks](/docs/webhook-download).

# clients.mdx

Source: https://github.com/gotenberg/gotenberg.dev/blob/main/docs/getting-started/clients.mdx

---
id: clients
title: Clients & SDKs
---

Gotenberg is a standard HTTP API. Any HTTP library works. Dedicated clients offer fluent interfaces, type safety, and simpler file handling.

## Official Client

The official **PHP** client has day-one support for new features:

- [gotenberg/gotenberg-php](https://github.com/gotenberg/gotenberg-php)

## Community Clients

Clients for most major languages are available on the [**Awesome Gotenberg**](https://github.com/gotenberg/awesome-gotenberg#clients) list.

Don't see your language? The API uses standard `multipart/form-data`, so building a wrapper is straightforward. Check the [routes overview](/docs/getting-started/routes) to get started.

## What's Next?

Convert your first file with a [Chromium route](/docs/convert-with-chromium/convert-url-to-pdf), or deliver results asynchronously with [webhooks](/docs/webhook-download).

---

# installation.mdx

Source: https://github.com/gotenberg/gotenberg.dev/blob/main/docs/getting-started/installation.mdx

---
id: installation
title: Installation
---

Don't expose Gotenberg to the public internet. Treat it like a database: keep it behind your firewall.

## Live Demo

Try the API without installing anything:

- https://demo.gotenberg.dev

Open a terminal and run:

```bash
curl \
--request POST https://demo.gotenberg.dev/forms/chromium/convert/url \
--form url=https://sparksuite.github.io/simple-html-invoice-template/ \
-o my.pdf
```

The demo runs on a [Render](https://render.com) instance (512MB RAM, 0.5 CPU) with rate limits: 2 requests/second per IP, 5MB body limit.

## Docker

```bash
docker run --rm -p "3000:3000" gotenberg/gotenberg:8
```

The API is now available at [http://localhost:3000](http://localhost:3000).

By default, published ports are accessible from the outside world. Bind to localhost for a more secure setup:

```bash
docker run --rm -p "127.0.0.1:3000:3000" gotenberg/gotenberg:8
```

## Image Variants

Gotenberg ships three image variants:

| Image                               | Size         | Includes                                                                     |
| :---------------------------------- | :----------- | :--------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `gotenberg/gotenberg:8`             | Full         | Chromium, LibreOffice, and PDF Engines.                                      |
| `gotenberg/gotenberg:8-chromium`    | ~30% smaller | Chromium and PDF Engines. No office document conversion.                     |
| `gotenberg/gotenberg:8-libreoffice` | ~40% smaller | LibreOffice and PDF Engines. No URL/HTML/Markdown conversion or screenshots. |

All variants include PDF Engines (merge, split, encrypt, watermark, metadata, bookmarks, attachments, etc.).

### Feature Availability

| Feature                                                | Full | Chromium | LibreOffice |
| :----------------------------------------------------- | :--: | :------: | :---------: |
| URL / HTML / Markdown to PDF                           |  ✅  |    ✅    |     ❌      |
| Screenshots                                            |  ✅  |    ✅    |     ❌      |
| Office document conversion (.docx, .xlsx, .pptx, etc.) |  ✅  |    ❌    |     ✅      |
| Merge, split, rotate, flatten PDFs                     |  ✅  |    ✅    |     ✅      |
| Encrypt, watermark, stamp PDFs                         |  ✅  |    ✅    |     ✅      |
| Read/write metadata & bookmarks                        |  ✅  |    ✅    |     ✅      |
| File attachments                                       |  ✅  |    ✅    |     ✅      |
| Factur-X / ZUGFeRD e-invoicing                         |  ✅  |    ❌    |     ✅      |
| PDF/A & PDF/UA conversion                              |  ✅  |    ❌    |     ✅      |
| Webhooks & async processing                            |  ✅  |    ✅    |     ✅      |
| Download from remote URLs                              |  ✅  |    ✅    |     ✅      |

Requesting an unavailable feature returns an error.

## Docker Compose

```yaml title="compose.yaml"
services:
  # Your other services.

  gotenberg:
    image: gotenberg/gotenberg:8
```

Other services in the same Compose network can reach Gotenberg at `gotenberg:3000`.

To also expose it on your host, add a `ports` section:

```yaml title="compose.yaml"
services:
  # Your other services.

  gotenberg:
    image: gotenberg/gotenberg:8
    ports:
      - "3000:3000"
      # Or more secure:
      # - "127.0.0.1:3000:3000"
```

## Kubernetes

The image runs as a non-root user `gotenberg` (UID/GID **1001**). Since _8.21.0_, [arbitrary user IDs (OpenShift)](https://docs.redhat.com/en/documentation/openshift_container_platform/4.15/html/images/creating-images#enable-images-for-source-to-image_create-images) are also supported.

Include this in your pod’s deployment spec:

```yaml
securityContext:
  readOnlyRootFilesystem: false
  allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
  privileged: false
  runAsUser: 1001 # unless using an arbitrarily assigned user ID.
```

Allocate at least 512Mi of memory and 0.2 CPU. A community-maintained Helm chart is available at [MaikuMori/helm-charts](https://github.com/MaikuMori/helm-charts) ([ArtifactHub](https://artifacthub.io/packages/helm/maikumori/gotenberg)).

## Cloud Run

```
gotenberg/gotenberg:8-cloudrun
gotenberg/gotenberg:8-chromium-cloudrun
gotenberg/gotenberg:8-libreoffice-cloudrun
```

Preconfigured for Cloud Run:

- Uses the `PORT` environment variable provided by Cloud Run.
- Logs in a format compatible with Cloud Run.
- Auto-starts Chromium and LibreOffice for faster readiness.
- Uses synchronous webhook mode, since Cloud Run may stop the container if there’s no HTTP activity.

Allocate at least 1Gi of memory for a [smooth experience](https://github.com/gotenberg/gotenberg/issues/950#issuecomment-2329228662). Consider HTTP/2 to bypass the [32MB request size limit](https://cloud.google.com/run/quotas?hl=en).

## AWS Lambda (Beta)

Available on `linux/amd64` and `linux/arm64`:

```
gotenberg/gotenberg:8-aws-lambda
gotenberg/gotenberg:8-chromium-aws-lambda
gotenberg/gotenberg:8-libreoffice-aws-lambda
```

Preconfigured for AWS Lambda:

- Uses the `AWS_LWA_PORT` environment variable to configure its port.
- Set `AWS_LWA_READINESS_CHECK_PATH` with the route `/health`.
- Set `AWS_LWA_INVOKE_MODE` with the value `buffered`.
- Uses synchronous webhook mode, since AWS may stop the container if there’s no HTTP activity.
- See https://github.com/awslabs/aws-lambda-web-adapter for more AWS related options.

The `buffered` invoke mode supports responses up to 6MB. For larger outputs, use the webhook feature to upload results to S3.

There is an [ongoing discussion](https://github.com/gotenberg/gotenberg/issues/540) about improving this variant. Feedback welcome.

## What's Next?

Install a [client](clients) or jump to the [routes overview](/docs/getting-started/routes).

---

# 1. Start the container.

Source: https://github.com/gotenberg/gotenberg.dev/blob/main/docs/getting-started/introduction.mdx

---
id: introduction
title: What is Gotenberg?
---

[Gotenberg](https://github.com/gotenberg/gotenberg) is a Docker-based API for converting documents to PDF. Send your files via `multipart/form-data`, get a PDF back. No need to manage Chromium, LibreOffice, or fonts yourself.

Beyond conversion, Gotenberg manipulates PDFs: merge, split, encrypt, watermark, metadata, and [Factur-X / ZUGFeRD e-invoicing](/docs/manipulate-pdfs/factur-x).

## Quick Start

Two commands to convert a URL to PDF:

```bash
# 1. Start the container.
docker run --rm -p "3000:3000" gotenberg/gotenberg:8
# 2. Convert a URL to PDF.
curl \
--request POST http://localhost:3000/forms/chromium/convert/url \
--form url=https://sparksuite.github.io/simple-html-invoice-template/ \
-o invoice.pdf
```

## What's Next?

Get started with Gotenberg by reading the [installation guide](installation), then pick your endpoint in the [routes overview](routes).

---

# routes.mdx

Source: https://github.com/gotenberg/gotenberg.dev/blob/main/docs/getting-started/routes.mdx

---
id: routes
title: Routes Overview
---

Every route accepts a `multipart/form-data` POST request and returns a file. Pick the route matching your task.

## Convert to PDF

| Task                                                      | Route                                                                                     |
| :-------------------------------------------------------- | :---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Convert a web page by URL                                 | [`/forms/chromium/convert/url`](/docs/convert-with-chromium/convert-url-to-pdf)           |
| Convert an HTML file                                      | [`/forms/chromium/convert/html`](/docs/convert-with-chromium/convert-html-to-pdf)         |
| Convert Markdown files                                    | [`/forms/chromium/convert/markdown`](/docs/convert-with-chromium/convert-markdown-to-pdf) |
| Convert office documents (`.docx`, `.xlsx`, `.pptx`, ...) | [`/forms/libreoffice/convert`](/docs/convert-with-libreoffice/convert-to-pdf)             |

## Screenshots

| Task                         | Route                                                                                    |
| :--------------------------- | :--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Screenshot a web page by URL | [`/forms/chromium/screenshot/url`](/docs/convert-with-chromium/screenshot-url)           |
| Screenshot an HTML file      | [`/forms/chromium/screenshot/html`](/docs/convert-with-chromium/screenshot-html)         |
| Screenshot Markdown files    | [`/forms/chromium/screenshot/markdown`](/docs/convert-with-chromium/screenshot-markdown) |

## Manipulate PDFs

| Task                                  | Route                                                                        |
| :------------------------------------ | :--------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Merge PDFs                            | [`/forms/pdfengines/merge`](/docs/manipulate-pdfs/merge-pdfs)                |
| Split PDFs                            | [`/forms/pdfengines/split`](/docs/manipulate-pdfs/split-pdfs)                |
| Convert to PDF/A or PDF/UA            | [`/forms/pdfengines/convert`](/docs/manipulate-pdfs/pdfa-pdfua)              |
| Read metadata                         | [`/forms/pdfengines/metadata/read`](/docs/manipulate-pdfs/read-metadata)     |
| Write metadata                        | [`/forms/pdfengines/metadata/write`](/docs/manipulate-pdfs/write-metadata)   |
| Read bookmarks                        | [`/forms/pdfengines/bookmarks/read`](/docs/manipulate-pdfs/read-bookmarks)   |
| Write bookmarks                       | [`/forms/pdfengines/bookmarks/write`](/docs/manipulate-pdfs/write-bookmarks) |
| Embed file attachments                | [`/forms/pdfengines/embed`](/docs/manipulate-pdfs/attachments)               |
| Produce Factur-X / ZUGFeRD e-invoices | [`/forms/pdfengines/factur-x`](/docs/manipulate-pdfs/factur-x)               |
| Flatten form fields and annotations   | [`/forms/pdfengines/flatten`](/docs/manipulate-pdfs/flatten-pdfs)            |
| Watermark PDFs                        | [`/forms/pdfengines/watermark`](/docs/manipulate-pdfs/watermark-pdfs)        |
| Stamp PDFs                            | [`/forms/pdfengines/stamp`](/docs/manipulate-pdfs/stamp-pdfs)                |
| Rotate PDFs                           | [`/forms/pdfengines/rotate`](/docs/manipulate-pdfs/rotate-pdfs)              |
| Encrypt PDFs                          | [`/forms/pdfengines/encrypt`](/docs/manipulate-pdfs/encrypt-pdfs)            |

Conversion routes accept most PDF engine features (metadata, attachments, watermark, encryption, ...) in the same request; see each route's feature sections.

## Operations

| Task                          | Route                                                 |
| :---------------------------- | :---------------------------------------------------- |
| Health check                  | [`/health`](/docs/system/get-health-check)            |
| Version                       | [`/version`](/docs/system/version)                    |
| Runtime configuration dump    | [`/debug`](/docs/system/debug)                        |
| Asynchronous processing       | [Webhooks](/docs/webhook-download)                    |
| Fetch inputs from remote URLs | [Download From](/docs/webhook-download#download-from) |

## What's Next?

Set up a [client](/docs/getting-started/clients) for your language, or jump straight to a [Chromium route](/docs/convert-with-chromium/convert-url-to-pdf).

# attachments.mdx

Source: https://github.com/gotenberg/gotenberg.dev/blob/main/docs/manipulate-pdfs/attachments.mdx

---
id: attachments
title: Attachments
---

import FacturXPDFEngines from "../_shared/_facturx_pdfengines.mdx";
import ConfigurationInfoPDFEngines from "../_shared/_configuration_info_pdfengines.mdx";

Embeds external files directly inside the PDF container. Commonly used for e-invoicing standards like **[ZUGFeRD / Factur-X](https://fnfe-mpe.org/factur-x/)**, which require a machine-readable XML invoice as an attachment.

<ConfigurationInfoPDFEngines />

Provide per-attachment metadata with `embedsMetadata` to satisfy PDF/A-3 and Factur-X requirements: each entry sets the embedded file stream's `/Subtype`, writes `/AFRelationship` on the file specification, and references the attachment from the Document Catalog's `/AF` array.

For Factur-X specifically, see the [Factur-X](#factur-x-pdf-engines) section below, or the dedicated [Factur-X](/docs/manipulate-pdfs/factur-x) route, where the fields are required and validated.

## Basics

  method="POST"
  path="/forms/pdfengines/embed"
  headers={[
      name: "Gotenberg-Output-Filename",
      type: "string",
      required: false,
        "The filename of the resulting file - Gotenberg automatically appends the file extension. Defaults to a random UUID filename.",
      name: "Gotenberg-Trace",
      type: "string",
      required: false,
        "A custom request ID to identify the request in the logs; overrides the default UUID.",
  formFiles={[
      name: "files",
      type: "file[]",
      required: true,
      description: "PDF files to embed content into.",
      name: "embeds",
      type: "file[]",
      required: true,
      description: "Files to embed (e.g., .xml, .png, etc.).",
  formFields={[
      name: "embedsMetadata",
      type: "json",
      defaultValue: "None",
        "Per-attachment metadata keyed by filename. Each entry accepts `mimeType` (written to the embedded file stream's `/Subtype`) and `relationship` (the `/AFRelationship` value, e.g., `Source`, `Data`, `Alternative`, `Supplement`, `Unspecified`). Requires a PDF engine that supports the feature (QPDF by default).",
  curl={`
--request POST http://localhost:3000/forms/pdfengines/embed \\
--form files=@/path/to/invoice.pdf \\
--form embeds=@/path/to/factur-x.xml \\
--form embedsMetadata='{"factur-x.xml":{"mimeType":"text/xml","relationship":"Alternative"}}' \\
-o my.pdf`}
  responses={[
      status: 200,
      message: "OK",
        "The PDF file with embedded attachments. Multiple input files produce a ZIP archive.",
      body: `
Content-Disposition: attachment; filename={output-filename.ext}
Content-Type: {content-type}
Content-Length: {content-length}
Gotenberg-Trace: {trace}
Body: {output-file}
      `,
      status: 400,
      message: "Bad Request",
      description: "The request had one or more invalid form fields.",
      body: `
Content-Type: text/plain; charset=UTF-8
Gotenberg-Trace: {trace}
Body: {error}
      `,
      status: 503,
      message: "Service Unavailable",
        "The request did not complete within the configured maximum duration.",
      body: `
Content-Type: text/plain; charset=UTF-8
Gotenberg-Trace: {trace}
Body: {error}
      `,

## Factur-X (PDF Engines)

<FacturXPDFEngines
  showFormFields={true}
  showCurlExample={true}
  method="POST"
  path="/forms/pdfengines/embed"
  curlFormData={`--form files=@/path/to/invoice.pdf \\`}
  curlOutput={`-o my.pdf`}

# factur-x.mdx

Source: https://github.com/gotenberg/gotenberg.dev/blob/main/docs/manipulate-pdfs/factur-x.mdx

---
id: factur-x
title: Factur-X
---

import ConfigurationInfoPDFEngines from "../_shared/_configuration_info_pdfengines.mdx";

Turns existing PDFs into [Factur-X / ZUGFeRD](https://fnfe-mpe.org/factur-x/) e-invoices: embeds the CII invoice XML under the canonical `factur-x.xml` name with the `Alternative` relationship, injects the Factur-X XMP metadata, and converts the PDF to PDF/A-3, the only PDF/A family that allows embedded files.

When every input already carries PDF/A-3 identification, the files are left untouched; otherwise the whole request converts to PDF/A-3b, or to the PDF/A-3 variant requested with `pdfa`. Requires a PDF engine that supports the feature (QPDF by default).

The [Chromium](/docs/convert-with-chromium/convert-html-to-pdf#factur-x-pdf-engines) and [LibreOffice](/docs/convert-with-libreoffice/convert-to-pdf#factur-x-pdf-engines) conversion routes accept the same form fields, so a single request can turn HTML or an office document into a compliant e-invoice.

<ConfigurationInfoPDFEngines />

## Basics

  method="POST"
  path="/forms/pdfengines/factur-x"
  headers={[
      name: "Gotenberg-Output-Filename",
      type: "string",
      required: false,
        "The filename of the resulting file - Gotenberg automatically appends the file extension. Defaults to a random UUID filename.",
      name: "Gotenberg-Trace",
      type: "string",
      required: false,
        "A custom request ID to identify the request in the logs; overrides the default UUID.",
  formFiles={[
      name: "files",
      type: "file[]",
      required: true,
      description: "PDF files to turn into Factur-X documents.",
      name: "facturxXml",
      type: "file",
      required: true,
        "The Factur-X CII invoice XML. Embedded as `factur-x.xml` regardless of the uploaded filename.",
  formFields={[
      name: "facturxConformanceLevel",
      type: "enum",
      required: true,
        "The Factur-X conformance level recorded in the XMP metadata. Options: `MINIMUM`, `BASIC WL`, `BASIC`, `EN 16931`, `EXTENDED`, `XRECHNUNG`.",
      name: "facturxDocumentType",
      type: "enum",
      defaultValue: "INVOICE",
        "The Factur-X document type. Options: `INVOICE`, `ORDER`, `ORDER_RESPONSE`, `ORDER_CHANGE`.",
      name: "facturxVersion",
      type: "string",
      defaultValue: "1.0",
      description: "The Factur-X version recorded in the XMP metadata.",
      name: "pdfa",
      type: "enum",
      required: false,
        "Converts to a specific PDF/A-3 variant. Options: `PDF/A-3a`, `PDF/A-3b`, `PDF/A-3u`. Other PDF/A formats return `400 Bad Request`. When unset, the whole request converts to PDF/A-3b unless every input is already PDF/A-3.",
      name: "pdfua",
      type: "boolean",
      defaultValue: "false",
      description: "Enables PDF/UA (Universal Accessibility) compliance.",
  curl={`
--request POST http://localhost:3000/forms/pdfengines/factur-x \\
--form files=@/path/to/invoice.pdf \\
--form facturxXml=@/path/to/factur-x.xml \\
--form 'facturxConformanceLevel=EN 16931' \\
-o my.pdf`}
  responses={[
      status: 200,
      message: "OK",
        "The Factur-X PDF file. Multiple input files produce a ZIP archive.",
      body: `
Content-Disposition: attachment; filename={output-filename.ext}
Content-Type: {content-type}
Content-Length: {content-length}
Gotenberg-Trace: {trace}
Body: {output-file}
      `,
      status: 400,
      message: "Bad Request",
      description: "The request had one or more invalid form fields.",
      body: `
Content-Type: text/plain; charset=UTF-8
Gotenberg-Trace: {trace}
Body: {error}
      `,
      status: 503,
      message: "Service Unavailable",
        "The request did not complete within the configured maximum duration.",
      body: `
Content-Type: text/plain; charset=UTF-8
Gotenberg-Trace: {trace}
Body: {error}
      `,

# merge-pdfs.mdx

id: merge-pdfs

import MetadataPDFEngines from "../_shared/_metadata_pdfengines.mdx";

## Structure & Metadata

### Metadata (PDF Engines)

<MetadataPDFEngines
  showFormFields={true}
  showCurlExample={true}
  method="POST"
  path="/forms/pdfengines/merge"
  curlFormData={`--form files=@/path/to/1_pdf.pdf \\
--form files=@/path/to/2_pdf.pdf \\
--form files=@/path/to/3_pdf.pdf \\`}
  curlOutput={`-o my.pdf`}

### Bookmarks (PDF Engines)

  formFields={[
      name: "bookmarks",
      type: "json",
      defaultValue: "None",
        "Bookmarks to write (JSON). A list applies to the final merged PDF. A map of filename→bookmarks shifts page indexes per file before merging.",
      name: "autoIndexBookmarks",
      type: "boolean",
      defaultValue: "false",
        "Extracts existing bookmarks from input files and offsets their page numbers based on their position in the merged document.",

Use `autoIndexBookmarks` to automatically extract existing bookmarks and offset their page numbers based on position in the merged document.

  curl={`
--request POST http://localhost:3000/forms/pdfengines/merge \\
--form files=@/path/to/1_pdf.pdf \\
--form files=@/path/to/2_pdf.pdf \\
--form files=@/path/to/3_pdf.pdf \\
--form autoIndexBookmarks=true \\
-o my.pdf`}

You can also provide custom bookmarks with the `bookmarks` form field. When provided as a **list**, it is applied directly to the final merged PDF. When provided as a **map** of filename to bookmarks, page indexes are shifted per file before merging.

Both options work together. When `autoIndexBookmarks` is enabled, Gotenberg respects your custom mappings for specific files while automatically recalculating indexes for the others.

  curl={`
--request POST http://localhost:3000/forms/pdfengines/merge \\
--form files=@/path/to/1_pdf.pdf \\
--form files=@/path/to/2_pdf.pdf \\
--form autoIndexBookmarks=true \\
--form 'bookmarks={"1_pdf.pdf":[{"title":"Introduction","page":1,"children":[]}],"2_pdf.pdf":[{"title":"Appendix","page":1,"children":[]}]}' \\
-o my.pdf`}

### Attachments (PDF Engines)

<AttachmentsPDFEngines
  showFormFields={true}
  showCurlExample={true}
  method="POST"
  path="/forms/pdfengines/merge"
  curlFormData={`--form files=@/path/to/1_pdf.pdf \\
--form files=@/path/to/2_pdf.pdf \\
--form files=@/path/to/3_pdf.pdf \\`}
  curlOutput={`-o my.pdf`}

# pdfa-pdfua.mdx

Source: https://github.com/gotenberg/gotenberg.dev/blob/main/docs/manipulate-pdfs/pdfa-pdfua.mdx

---
id: pdfa-pdfua
title: PDF/A & PDF/UA
---

import ConfigurationInfoPDFEngines from "../_shared/_configuration_info_pdfengines.mdx";

Converts one or more PDF files into PDF/A (archival) or PDF/UA (accessibility) format.

<ConfigurationInfoPDFEngines />

:::info LibreOffice Dependency

PDF/A and PDF/UA conversion relies on **LibreOffice** to re-process documents, which costs more CPU and RAM than simple merges or splits.

:::

## Basics

  method="POST"
  path="/forms/pdfengines/convert"
  headers={[
      name: "Gotenberg-Output-Filename",
      type: "string",
      required: false,
        "The filename of the resulting file - Gotenberg automatically appends the file extension. Defaults to a random UUID filename.",
      name: "Gotenberg-Trace",
      type: "string",
      required: false,
        "A custom request ID to identify the request in the logs; overrides the default UUID.",
  formFiles={[
      name: "files",
      type: "file[]",
      required: true,
      description: "PDF files to convert.",
  formFields={[
      name: "pdfa",
      type: "enum",
      required: false,
        "Converts to a specific PDF/A archival standard. Options: `PDF/A-1b`, `PDF/A-2b`, `PDF/A-3b`.",
      name: "pdfua",
      type: "boolean",
      defaultValue: "false",
      description: "Enables PDF/UA (Universal Accessibility) compliance.",
  curl={`
--request POST http://localhost:3000/forms/pdfengines/convert \\
--form files=@/path/to/pdf.pdf \\
--form pdfa=PDF/A-1b \\
--form pdfua=true \\
-o my.pdf`}
  responses={[
      status: 200,
      message: "OK",
        "The converted PDF file. Multiple input files produce a ZIP archive.",
      body: `
Content-Disposition: attachment; filename={output-filename.ext}
Content-Type: {content-type}
Content-Length: {content-length}
Gotenberg-Trace: {trace}
Body: {output-file}
      `,
      status: 400,
      message: "Bad Request",
      description: "The request had one or more invalid form fields.",
      body: `
Content-Type: text/plain; charset=UTF-8
Gotenberg-Trace: {trace}
Body: {error}
      `,
      status: 503,
      message: "Service Unavailable",
        "The request did not complete within the configured maximum duration.",
      body: `
Content-Type: text/plain; charset=UTF-8
Gotenberg-Trace: {trace}
Body: {error}
      `,

## What's Next?

Secure documents with [Encrypt](/docs/manipulate-pdfs/encrypt-pdfs), or deliver results asynchronously with [webhooks](/docs/webhook-download).

---

# read-bookmarks.mdx

Source: https://github.com/gotenberg/gotenberg.dev/blob/main/docs/manipulate-pdfs/read-bookmarks.mdx

---
id: read-bookmarks
title: Read Bookmarks
---

import ConfigurationInfoPDFEngines from "../_shared/_configuration_info_pdfengines.mdx";

Extracts bookmarks (the document outline / table of contents) from one or more PDF files. Returns a JSON object keyed by filename, where each bookmark contains a `title`, a `page` number, and optional `children`.

<ConfigurationInfoPDFEngines />

## Basics

  method="POST"
  path="/forms/pdfengines/bookmarks/read"
  headers={[
      name: "Gotenberg-Trace",
      type: "string",
      required: false,
        "A custom request ID to identify the request in the logs; overrides the default UUID.",
  formFiles={[
      name: "files",
      type: "file[]",
      required: true,
      description: "PDF files to analyze.",
  curl={`
--request POST http://localhost:3000/forms/pdfengines/bookmarks/read \\
--form files=@/path/to/document.pdf \\
--form files=@/path/to/report.pdf`}
  responses={[
      status: 200,
      message: "OK",
      description: "The bookmarks in JSON format.",
      body: `
Content-Type: application/json; charset=UTF-8
Content-Length: {content-length}
Gotenberg-Trace: {trace}
Body:
    "document.pdf": [
        "title": "Chapter 1",
        "page": 1,
        "children": [
            "title": "Section 1.1",
            "page": 3,
            "children": []
          }
        ]
        "title": "Chapter 2",
        "page": 10,
        "children": []
      }
    ],
    "report.pdf": [
        "title": "Introduction",
        "page": 1,
        "children": []
      }
    ]
}
      `,
      status: 400,
      message: "Bad Request",
      description: "The request had one or more invalid form fields.",
      body: `
Content-Type: text/plain; charset=UTF-8
Gotenberg-Trace: {trace}
Body: {error}
      `,
      status: 503,
      message: "Service Unavailable",
        "The request did not complete within the configured maximum duration.",
      body: `
Content-Type: text/plain; charset=UTF-8
Gotenberg-Trace: {trace}
Body: {error}
      `,

## What's Next?

Add bookmarks with [Write bookmarks](/docs/manipulate-pdfs/write-bookmarks), or embed files with [Attachments](/docs/manipulate-pdfs/attachments).

# read-metadata.mdx

Source: https://github.com/gotenberg/gotenberg.dev/blob/main/docs/manipulate-pdfs/read-metadata.mdx

---
id: read-metadata
title: Read Metadata
---

import ConfigurationInfoPDFEngines from "../_shared/_configuration_info_pdfengines.mdx";

Extracts metadata (Exif, XMP, PDF properties, etc.) from one or more PDF files using **ExifTool**. Returns a JSON object keyed by filename.

<ConfigurationInfoPDFEngines />

:::info ExifTool Tags
The returned keys correspond to ExifTool tag names.
[See the ExifTool Tag Names documentation](https://exiftool.org/TagNames/PDF.html) for reference on what fields might be returned.
:::

## Basics

  method="POST"
  path="/forms/pdfengines/metadata/read"
  headers={[
      name: "Gotenberg-Trace",
      type: "string",
      required: false,
        "A custom request ID to identify the request in the logs; overrides the default UUID.",
  formFiles={[
      name: "files",
      type: "file[]",
      required: true,
      description: "PDF files to analyze.",
  curl={`
--request POST http://localhost:3000/forms/pdfengines/metadata/read \\
--form files=@/path/to/invoice.pdf \\
--form files=@/path/to/report.pdf`}
  responses={[
      status: 200,
      message: "OK",
      description: "The metadata in JSON format.",
      body: `
Content-Type: application/json; charset=UTF-8
Content-Length: {content-length}
Gotenberg-Trace: {trace}
Body:
    "invoice.pdf": {
      "PDFVersion": 1.7,
      "Author": "Gotenberg",
      "Title": "Invoice #001",
      "CreateDate": "2024:03:05 09:15:32Z",
      "PageCount": 2,
      "Producer": "Gotenberg",
      "MIMEType": "application/pdf"
    "report.pdf": {
      "PDFVersion": 1.4,
      "Author": "John Doe",
      "PageCount": 15
      // ...
    }
}
      `,
      status: 400,
      message: "Bad Request",
      description: "The request had one or more invalid form fields.",
      body: `
Content-Type: text/plain; charset=UTF-8
Gotenberg-Trace: {trace}
Body: {error}
      `,
      status: 503,
      message: "Service Unavailable",
        "The request did not complete within the configured maximum duration.",
      body: `
Content-Type: text/plain; charset=UTF-8
Gotenberg-Trace: {trace}
Body: {error}
      `,

## What's Next?

Inspect document structure with [Read bookmarks](/docs/manipulate-pdfs/read-bookmarks), or set your own with [Write metadata](/docs/manipulate-pdfs/write-metadata).
